primary.name: Bronzed Gold / Champagne
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, borders, highlights, floating WhatsApp button, icons, text accents

secondary.name: Champagne Gold (Muted)
secondary.usage: Hover states, subtle borders, thin dividing lines

surface.name: Dark Obsidian
surface.usage: Card backgrounds, section alternates, input fields, AI chat window

headings.usage: Hero titles, section headers, menu categories, logo fallback. Must evoke nobility and elegance. Tracking-tight for large text.

body.usage: Descriptions, service text, forms. Must be light and highly readable.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3) for elegant separation. Gold accents on hover.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft golden glow `shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.1)]` on primary buttons and AI chat.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the dark background to avoid flat black.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded. Primary: Gold border, transparent bg, gold text (or gold bg, black text). Floating WA button: Gold bg (#D4AF37), black icon, NOT green.
visual_enhancers.badges: Thin gold border, uppercase serif text, very elegant. Examples: 'Prenotazione Obbligatoria', 'Camino', 'Friggitoria Napoletana'.

layouts.hero: Monumental full-screen. Background: dark image of gourmet pizza or fire. Large RR monogram reveal on load. Centered elegant text. Two CTA buttons (Gold outline and solid gold).
layouts.philosophy: Split layout or staggered bento grid. Storytelling of Friggitoria + Contemporary Pizza. Ample negative space.
layouts.menu: Tabs or scroll-spy sections. Categories: Pizze Gourmet, Tradizione, Panuozzi, Fritti, Beverage. Elegant list format with dotted leaders or right-aligned prices.
layouts.gallery: Vertical luxury gallery (3-4 vertical photos in a row) taking up full width or a masonry style. Must feel like a high-end fashion editorial.
layouts.delivery: Premium take-away section with WhatsApp CTA.
layouts.footer: Dark stylized map, opening hours (Tuesday Closed highlighted in gold), mandatory reservation notice, RR logo.

motion.reveal: Framer Motion for elegant fade-ins, slide-ups (`y: 20, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1`). Slow easing (`duration: 0.8, ease: 'easeOut'`).
motion.marquee: Editorial marquee for 'Pizzeria e Friggitoria Napoletana' in large outline text.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic monumental reveal of the RR monogram and main title on load.

features.ai_concierge: A chat interface (Claude) positioned elegantly (maybe bottom left or accessible via a button). Styled in obsidian and gold. Suggests dishes.
features.reservation_form: Luxury form (Name, Date, Time, Guests). On submit, generates a pre-filled WhatsApp message. NO DATABASE required.
features.whatsapp_floating: Fixed position, Champagne Gold color. Pre-filled message for delivery/takeaway or info.

image_urls.description: Gourmet Neapolitan pizza with cheese (Hero / Menu)
Golden arancini on a sleek black plate (Gallery 2 / Fritti)

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion for scroll animations and the kinetic hero reveal.
Use lucide-react for icons (WhatsApp, Map, Chevron, etc.).
For the 'RR' logo, use an SVG text element or a stylized initial in 'Playfair Display' if the actual image is not present in the workspace.
Ensure the floating WhatsApp button is GOLD (#D4AF37), NOT green.
The reservation form should strictly construct a WhatsApp URL (`https://wa.me/393288188273?text=...`) and open it in a new tab.
The AI Concierge should be a visually stunning chat interface (dark obsidian + gold) simulating Claude. It can use mock responses if a real LLM isn't hooked up.
Maintain strict luxury aesthetics: abundant negative space, no cheap gradients, thin 1px gold borders (`border-[#D4AF37]/30`).
Ensure all text meets accessibility contrast ratios against the absolute black background.
Do not use generic blue/green SaaS colors anywhere.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; over black, use backdrop-blur with rgba(13,13,13,0.8).
Never use emoji characters like 🤖 or 🍕 for icons. Use proper vector icons.
Prioritize using existing UI components, customize them for the luxury dark theme.
